rows.label: Formula
rows.text: Parent-chain + locant(s) + sub-prefix + suffix = IUPAC name

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: ❌ treat "Classification" as one blob → ✅ split into: classification, nomenclature, preparation.  ·  ❌ state the rule without its limit → ✅ note when it applies / stops applying.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: IUPAC: identify parent chain (longest), number from end nearer the functional group / first substituent; suffix by priority (−ol, −al, −one, −oic acid…).  ·  Carbocation/carbanion stability: 3° > 2° > 1° > methyl; resonance stabilises; inductive effect transmits through sigma bonds.

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: Preparation bank: reduction of nitro compounds (Sn/HCl or H2/Pd), ammonolysis of alkyl halides (excess NH3 to stop polyalkylation), Gabriel phthalimide (1° ONLY), Hofmann bromamide (RCONH2 + Br2/KOH → RNH2, one carbon LESS).  ·  Trick 2: Hofmann bromamide's 'one carbon less' is the exam trap — the carbonyl carbon leaves as carbonate; quote it.
